limits.en: Retained historical diagnostic; reviewed output does not establish a rerun, complete raw-share accounting, point-in-time availability or executable return.

conclusion.zh: 保留的修复序列明确不作为主净值，并保留缺失持仓限制。

title.en: Separating size from liquidity and trading activity
title.zh: 区分规模、流动性与交易活跃度

family.zh: 规则重建、剔除与账户核对

limits.en: Retained historical diagnostic; reviewed output does not establish a rerun, complete raw-share accounting, point-in-time availability or executable return.
limits.zh: 这里复核保留的历史诊断输出，尚未重新运行研究。原始股数账户的完整性和数据在历史时点的可得性仍待核实，收益能否实际实现也尚未验证。

conclusion.en: Conditional common-support results weaken a simple size interpretation; this remains retrospective, not causal.
conclusion.zh: 共同样本的条件检验结果对单纯的规模解释提出了疑问。结果仅支持回溯关联，因果关系仍待验证。

title.en: Maximum drawdown and recovery in the retained rule

limits.en: Retained historical diagnostic; reviewed output does not establish a rerun, complete raw-share accounting, point-in-time availability or executable return.

title.en: How much actually trades among the smallest N?
title.zh: 最小 N 只股票究竟有多少成交？

family.zh: 最小 N 只股票成交额

limits.en: Exploratory retained output. Compare only matching clocks, universes, fees and units; no untouched holdout or investment recommendation.
limits.zh: 保留输出用于探索性研究。比较时需对齐时钟、样本、费用与单位。研究没有未经使用的留出样本，内容仅供研究参考。

conclusion.en: Daily size ranks and annual traded-value medians preserve the CNY unit and observed coverage.
conclusion.zh: 每日规模排名与年度成交额中位数保留人民币单位和观测覆盖。

title.en: Observatory factor distribution demonstration
title.zh: 因子观察站分布演示

family.zh: 仅作演示

stage.zh: 合成数据演示，仅用于展示功能

limits.en: 42 synthetic dates and three synthetic tickers. Only aggregate distribution rows are migrated. These numbers cannot support a size premium, liquidity effect, forecast or strategy return.
limits.zh: 42个合成日期、3个合成证券。仅迁移分布汇总行。这些数值不能支持规模溢价、流动性效应、预测或策略收益。

title.en: Historical variance and jump-risk decomposition
title.zh: 历史方差与跳跃风险分解

family.zh: 因子观察站归档风险背景

stage.en: Archived descriptive panel; no PIT qualification
stage.zh: 归档描述面板。未取得历史时点资格

conclusion.en: Pooled jump-related variance share varies across the retained years. This provides risk context without testing a small-cap premium.
conclusion.zh: 保留年份中的汇总跳跃相关方差占比发生变化。这些结果用于描述风险背景，小盘溢价仍待另行检验。

limits.en: Archived China A-share risk panel, 2021–24 April 2026: 1,285 observed dates and 6,931,290 aligned stock-days; 2026 is partial. Not current-market data or point-in-time qualified. Positive RJV prevalence is not a calibrated jump-event frequency; pooled variance shares are not event counts. No size stratification, portfolio validation, incremental prediction or execution evidence.
limits.zh: 归档风险面板覆盖中国 A 股2021年至2026年4月24日的1,285个观测日期和6,931,290个对齐证券日，2026年仅覆盖部分区间。数据用于描述历史风险，历史时点资格尚未核实。RJV为正的比例只描述指标分布，跳跃事件频率尚未经校准。汇总方差占比衡量方差构成，未统计事件数量。研究没有按规模分组，也未验证组合表现、增量预测或实际执行。

title.en: Smallest-N annual traded value
title.zh: 最小 N 只股票的年度成交额

limits.en: China A-shares; clean 2015–2026 observed daily ranks. Traded value is CNY, not a turnover rate or portfolio turnover.
limits.zh: 研究按中国 A 股2015至2026年清洁样本的每日市值排名分组。指标为以人民币计价的成交额，股票换手率和组合换手需另行计算。

title.en: Exclusions, buffers and modeled cost drag
title.zh: 剔除、缓冲与模拟成本损耗

limits.en: 2015–July 2026 retained outputs, not a fresh rerun. Historical fee and code revision are unknown; 10 bps is protocol default, not recovered historical cost.
limits.zh: 结果来自2015至2026年7月的保留输出，未重新回测。历史费用和代码版本未知。10基点为协议默认值，原历史成本仍待确认。

units.en: percent / annual multiple / percentage points / ratio
units.zh: 百分比／年倍数／百分点／比率

title.en: Does size survive liquidity and activity conditioning?
title.zh: 控制流动性和活跃度后，规模效应还在吗？

limits.en: 137 retrospective formations, February 2015–June 2026; returns through July 2026. Common support, HAC(3). Confidence bounds are statistical summaries, not causal identification; no costs or untouched holdout.
limits.zh: 检验覆盖2015年2月至2026年6月的137个回溯形成期，收益截至2026年7月。检验使用共同样本和HAC（3）标准误。置信区间描述估计的不确定性，因果关系尚未识别。结果未计成本，也没有未经使用的留出样本。

units.en: return fraction / t statistic / formations / fraction
units.zh: 收益比例／t 统计量／形成期数／比例

title.en: Low-turnover candidates and blocked trading days
title.zh: 低换手候选组合与交易受阻日

limits.en: 2015–July 2026 exploratory comparisons. Residualization and constraints can reverse a headline result. Low stock turnover does not imply low portfolio turnover.
limits.zh: 这是2015至2026年7月的探索性比较。残差化与交易约束可能改变比较结果。股票自身的换手率与组合调仓换手需要分别测量。

units.zh: 百分比／比率／年倍数／交易日

title.en: Annual liquidity and turnover stability across markets
title.zh: 跨市场年度流动性与换手稳定性

limits.en: Daily cross-sectional medians → monthly medians → annual distribution. P25–P75 describes temporal spread, not a confidence interval. Current source vintage; no historical PIT certification or cross-market ranking.
limits.zh: 先计算每日横截面中位数，再取月中位数，最后汇总年度分布。P25至P75描述指标随时间的分布，未估计置信区间。研究使用当前数据版本，历史时点资格尚未核实，结果仅作描述性比较。

units.zh: 美元／换手率比例／月数／证券日观测数

title.en: Forward exit scenarios for frozen China A-share cohorts
title.zh: 中国 A 股固定样本的未来退出情景

limits.en: 2024–2025 formation cohorts; 1/5/20 observed-session horizons. Participation is an assumed budget, not fills; guarded paths keep missingness visible. No calibrated actual execution or historical PIT eligibility. Counts pool stock–formation observations, not unique securities. Uncredited fraction uses remaining budget/notional balances, not the count of uncovered names.
limits.zh: 样本形成于2024至2025年，分别观察1／5／20个交易日的期限。参与率用于设定预算，实际成交仍待校准，保守路径保留缺失情况。历史时点资格尚未核实。数量按股票与形成期的组合观测汇总，同一证券可重复计数。未计入比例以预算／持仓名义金额为分母，未覆盖股票数量需单独查看。

units.zh: 股票与形成期组合观测数／观测交易日／比例

title.en: Observatory distribution explorer — synthetic demonstration
title.zh: 因子观察站合成数据分布演示

title.en: Observatory archived annual jump-risk decomposition
title.zh: 因子观察站归档年度跳跃风险分解

limits.en: Archived China A-share risk panel, 2021–24 April 2026: 1,285 observed dates and 6,931,290 aligned stock-days; 2026 is partial. Not current-market data or point-in-time qualified. Positive RJV prevalence is not a calibrated jump-event frequency; pooled variance shares are not event counts. No size stratification, portfolio validation, incremental prediction or execution evidence.
limits.zh: 归档风险面板覆盖中国 A 股2021年至2026年4月24日的1,285个观测日期和6,931,290个对齐证券日，2026年仅覆盖部分区间。数据用于描述历史风险，历史时点资格尚未核实。RJV为正的比例只描述指标分布，跳跃事件频率尚未经校准。汇总方差占比衡量方差构成，未统计事件数量。研究没有按规模分组，也未验证组合表现、增量预测或实际执行。

units.en: variance fractions / stock-days / observed dates / distinct sampled securities
units.zh: 方差比例／证券日／观测日期／不同样本证券数
